title: Places in Town
text:
I live in a small town. There are many places here. The library is on Main Street. It is next to the bank. I go to the library every week.

The park is near my house. There are trees and a big lake. Children play on the swings. On Sunday, my family has lunch in the park. We like it very much.

questions.text: What is near the writer's house?
What kind of family is it probably?
options: They like to spend time outdoors together
They do not like the park

questions.text: Why is the park a good place for children?
options: There are swings to play on

vocabulary.definition: a place with many books that people can borrow
a place where people keep their money
a large public garden with trees and grass
seats hung from ropes that children move back and forth

paragraph_translations: Я живу в маленькому місті. Тут багато цікавих місць. Бібліотека знаходиться на головній вулиці. Вона поруч з банком. Я ходжу до бібліотеки кожного тижня.
Парк недалеко від мого будинку. Там є дерева і велике озеро. Діти граються на гойдалках. У неділю моя родина обідає в парку. Нам це дуже подобається.
